Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 138. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 20 Ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 90 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: omni
A frisbee like attack that can cut through almost
anything.
Roll an Omni Attack Roll dealing 4d12 slashing
damage on a hit. This damage deals double damage to
structures and constructs.
